_label: Lord-I-Call sticheron at verse (2), Synaxis of the Bodiless Powers (11-08)

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Archangel Michael and the Other Bodiless Powers

_note: Two OCA editions of one hymn. The base is the OCA service-texts DOCX (reference/scrape/2024-11-08.docx, "Prepared by the Department of Liturgical Music and Translations"); the parish sings the OCA engraved-music setting (© 2019 OCA) printed in its choir packet. Register is NOT the whole difference and a ?pronoun=yy render does not reach this wording — see memory project_register_knob_is_service_wide.

_provenance.family_note: OCA. The OCA service-texts DOCX; identical to the stichera row it stands in for.

value.text:
Standing before the throne of the three-fold radiance of the Godhead, brilliant with the splendors that unceasingly pour forth from It, from the fog of passions free those of us on earth who praise thee with joy! Illumine us, O Chief Captain Gabriel,
thou intercessor for our souls!

variants.label: OCA engraved-music setting, as the parish sings it

Tone 4, position (2). Colophon on the packet's last page: "© 2019 Orthodox Church in America". Read VISUALLY from the scan, not from the OCR sidecar. Chant marks (//) kept as printed; the director's pencil underlay marks are melodic, not textual, and are not transcribed.

value.text:
Standing before the throne of the tri-luminary Godhead,
brilliant with the rays of its unceasing light:
save from the passions of darkness
those on earth who praise you joyfully!
Illumine them, Gabriel the archangel,//
the intercessor for our souls!
